messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: SERVICE-DEGRADED - multi-region health probe yo-yo detected across us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. Smart-routing fallback loop observed causing intermittent 502s and tail latency spikes. Incident INC-20260315-42. Paging @oncall.
sara: ack, I'm the oncall. pulling dashboards and logs now.
lee: I'm joining. which routing policy is in play? any recent changes to variant names?
priya: routing policy = latency-first, fallback list = [gpt-large-v2, gpt-small-quant]. fyi we had a rename last week where gpt-small-q4 -> gpt-small-quant, might be a mapping edge case.
michael: seeing health toggles in the router every ~18-25s for the same customer sessions. when a region is marked unhealthy it falls back to a variant in the next region, that region's probe flips to unhealthy shortly after (probe traffic amplification).
lee: can we paste a short log sample?
michael: sure, from router-a-us-east (ts ~1733334460):
```
2026-03-15T12:07:40Z router-a-us-east route_id=R-1234 health=FAIL -> fallback=us-west:gpt-small-quant
2026-03-15T12:07:58Z router-a-us-east health=OK
2026-03-15T12:08:01Z router-b-us-west probe=FAIL reason=kv-cache-miss? fallback->eu:gpt-large-v2
2026-03-15T12:08:20Z router-b-us-west health=OK
```
michael: you can see the pattern; probes bounce when fallback traffic lands and back-probes trigger more fallbacks.
sara: hypothesis: two compounding issues — (1) variant name mapping mismatch causing traffic to different model binaries with different probe behaviour, (2) probe debounce too short so probe noise forms a feedback loop.
priya: agree. mitigation plan: immediate = disable cross-region fallback for affected product-tier and pin primary region; short-term = increase probe debounce to 30s and add a variant-safe mapping; long-term = add chaos-resistant probe logic and a canary for variant renames.
sara: applying temporary override now:
```
# pin routing to primary region for product=search-api
rbctl route override set --scope=product:search-api --policy=primary-only --expires=+30m --by=sara
```
ops-bot: route override applied: scope=product:search-api policy=primary-only expires=+30m by=sara (op-id: OV-7721)
lee: metrics after override show immediate drop in cross-region fallback events (~72% reduction) and 502s trending down.
priya: i'm also patching the variant mapping in the routing catalog to accept the old alias `gpt-small-q4` as `gpt-small-quant` to avoid future mismatches. pushing small config change.
deploy-bot: config-push: routing-catalog update (refs/heads/patch/variant-alias) started by priya
deploy-bot: config-push: succeeded in 18s (change id cfg-9987)
michael: opened GH issue for improved probe debounce and telemetry correlation: GH#9876. noted possible cache pressure when variants mismatch (kv lookups spike).
sara: customer impact summary for pager: approx 1.2k requests affected in 15m window, tail latency up to +600ms for ~4 customers (noted AcmeCorp, NimbusAI). CS notified; watch for escalations.
lee: handing off live monitor to night oncall @jordan in 15m. will keep override until we validate patch.
jordan: ack, i'll take it. alert rules adjusted to suppress noisy probe flips while we observe.
sara: next steps (short): 1) keep primary-only override 30m -> extend if stable, 2) validate variant alias fix + rollback unsafe renames, 3) increase probe debounce from 5s -> 30s across routing fleet, 4) run controlled canary for fallback behaviour.
priya: also adding an alert that surfaces 'fallback amplification' (fallbacks triggered by probe state transitions within 60s window) so this pattern gets auto-detected.
ops-bot: override OV-7721 auto-extended by sara for +60m (new expiry +90m)
sara: removing manual sensitive fallbacks once canary looks good. documenting runbook updates in the incident tracker.
deploy-bot: healthcheck-debounce patch deploy started by priya (job jd-554)
deploy-bot: healthcheck-debounce patch deployed to majority in 3m22s; monitoring for regressions.
lee: still seeing a couple of isolated probe flips, but not cascading. keeping watch.
jordan: will watch till 0200 UTC, will escalate if flips resume.
sara: handing off formal incident write-up to priya and michael for postmortem. thanks all — good triage. :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack thread style: messages are chronological, prefixed by sender. No title field per agents.md.
